knowledgeSources.title: Issuer Alpha Enterprise Cloud CE 3.0 Verification Playbook
knowledgeSources.headingPath: Tenant Playbook > Issuer Alpha > Cloud Renewals
knowledgeSources.content: For cloud infrastructure renewals above $250, combine CE 3.0 device fingerprint telemetry (contact: security@issuer-alpha.example) with historical OAuth2 SSO session logs on test PAN 4111-1111-1111-1111.

knowledgeSources.title: Acquirer Beta Tap-to-Pay Duplicate Terminal Settlement Rule
knowledgeSources.headingPath: Tenant Playbook > Acquirer Beta > Transit Terminals
knowledgeSources.content: When two contactless tap authorizations share Terminal ID T4B-01 within 90 seconds, verify distinct ride trip IDs before representment; otherwise accept liability immediately.
